summary: Iteration 215d6.1 mobile modal testing. CRITICAL BUG: All modals (Add Member, etc.) have Save/Cancel buttons hidden off-screen on mobile due to CSS transform on <MAIN> element breaking position:fixed. Module Switcher routing and CRM SSO work correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Save/Cancel buttons hidden off-screen on mobile (390x844). Modal height is 1984px but viewport is 844px. Save button at y=1833px is unreachable.
ui_bugs.root_cause: The <MAIN> element has transform: matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0) which creates a new containing block for position:fixed elements. The modal's fixed positioning becomes relative to <MAIN> (1984px tall) instead of the viewport (844px). The safe-zone container (top-16 bottom-16) is 1856px instead of 716px.

ui_bugs.issue: Same issue affects desktop (1440x900). Modal height 1362px, viewport 900px, Save button at y=1008px.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix modal positioning - either (1) remove transform from <MAIN> element, (2) render modals in a React Portal at document.body level, or (3) use a different positioning strategy that doesn't rely on position:fixed
The transform on <MAIN> is likely from a CSS animation or transition - investigate why it has transform: matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) even when no animation is active
Alternative fix: Use position:absolute with explicit height calculations instead of relying on position:fixed with inset
critical_code_review_comments: ModalShell uses position:fixed with inset:0 but this breaks when any ancestor has transform property
The safe-zone pattern (top-16 bottom-16) is correct but ineffective due to the transform issue
Consider using React Portal (ReactDOM.createPortal) to render modals outside the <MAIN> element

rca_of_the_issue.problem: Modal Save/Cancel buttons hidden off-screen on mobile and desktop
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The <MAIN> element has CSS transform: matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0) which creates a new containing block for position:fixed descendants. This is a known CSS behavior - when any ancestor has a transform property (even identity matrix), fixed positioning becomes relative to that ancestor instead of the viewport.
reproduction_steps: 1. Login as admin@gymaxisai.com on mobile viewport (390x844)
5. Observe modal - Save/Cancel buttons are not visible
6. Scrolling does not help - the scroll container is not scrollable
suggested_fixes: Option 1: Remove transform from <MAIN> element (may break animations)
Option 2: Use ReactDOM.createPortal to render modals at document.body level
Option 3: Use position:absolute with explicit height calculations
Option 4: Add overflow:hidden to body when modal is open and use viewport units
